usageNotes: Use this as the first step in an OpenID Connect login flow: POST the realm name and your application's redirect-url to receive the provider's authorization URL, then redirect the browser to that URL. No authentication is required — this endpoint is world-accessible by design. The redirect-url must exactly match a URI registered with the OpenID provider, or the provider will reject the subsequent callback.

examples.summary: Initiate OpenID login for the 'corp-sso' realm, redirecting back to a local dashboard

tips: The returned string is a full URL — redirect the user's browser to it; do not call it server-side.
The realm must already be configured in PDM as an OpenID Connect realm before this call will succeed.
Mismatched redirect-url values (not registered with the identity provider) will cause a provider-side error after the redirect, not a PDM API error.
Because no token or cookie is required, this endpoint is safe to call from a browser or unauthenticated proxy.
